reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin for managing named system-prompt templates with global defaults and per-workspace overrides, then injecting the selected template into conversations.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中管理命名系统提示词模板，并按全局或工作区选择后注入会话。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin for managing named system-prompt templates and injecting a selected template into conversations globally or by workspace.

capabilities: Applies a selected template globally or per workspace
Injects template text into each conversation's system prompt
Stores plugin settings and installs plugin files into the DeepSeek Harness profile
